propositions: git commit --amend -F or -m drops the Change-Id trailer, causing Gerrit to stamp a new one and open a duplicate change instead of a new patchset
A prepare-commit-msg hook cannot detect and prevent amends with -F, because git does not distinguish an -F amend from a fresh -F commit at hook invocation time
A make amend-msg FILE=<path> wrapper must extract HEAD's existing Change-Id, preserve it through the amend, and fail loudly if HEAD has no Change-Id
AGENTS.md documentation must name make amend-msg as the documented path for rewritten commit messages and warn that --amend -m/-F create duplicate changes
No pre-push hook, reflog comparison, or other novel guard mechanism should be added; the wrapper makes the failure mode unreachable rather than detectable
